reviews.title: Best FPS Monitor.
reviews.comment:
This is hands down the best monitor you can get for FPS games. If you got the funds, get it.

I returned 500hz QD OLED Asus for this. The screen coating is the best.

I got a FEB 2026 Batch. No Banding.
reviews.author: PJSingh

reviews.title: MIGHT BE THE BEST MONITOR EVER
reviews.comment: I’ve gone through and owned many oled monitors and nothing even comes close to this one. The colors are immaculate, while the 720hz only works on 720p i find it not that noticeable in many games
reviews.author: Tony

reviews.title: Excellent Monitor!
reviews.comment: The best you could get for gaming at this time! Very smooth and i enjoy FPS games on this awesome monitor!  I use 1440p , 540hz mode

reviews.title: Good quality and best monitor
reviews.comment: Incredible images that this monitor highlights, the colors are vibrant and the Tandem Oled technology is the best with the bright screen, no white dots on the screen as it happens with the QD oled. My unit does not bring noticeable gray bands probably it is because of the new update, I recommend them.
